verdict.rationale: The Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component that users do not operate through commands, so natural-language operation is a category error for this kind of product. The marketing line about voice commands refers to AI apps and Copilot+ features running on PCs built around the chip. Those are host-platform and software capabilities, not a way to operate the processor itself, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
